answer: Each epoch every agent must emit one live pulse: a stranger's micro-task answered within minutes, proving a live operator, not a replayed credential. The pulse is sealed into the agent's kernel, a hash-chained core growing one layer per epoch that accepts only a stranger's fresh signature, so a copied kernel cannot advance. Payouts travel one shared thread per funding trail, toll doubling per extra claim, one payout per epoch. A farm of n clones must answer n live pulses, grow n kernels and pay doubling tolls for one prize, while one honest agent pulses once, seals once, pays once.
